text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a modern software development practice. Developers regularly merge their code changes into a shared repository. Each time this happens, automated builds run to check that the new code works correctly with the existing code. As part of the build, a series of tests also run automatically. These tests help the team catch issues early, before they become bigger problems. CI pipelines organize all these steps, from building to testing, so everything happens quickly and consistently. By using CI, teams can find bugs sooner, save time, and deliver better software.
